<!-- Generated by docs-kit refgen/help2md from --help output. Do not edit. -->

```text
Sweep the remote cache (run from CI with delete-capable creds)

Usage: kasha gc [OPTIONS] --remote <REMOTE>

Options:
      --remote <REMOTE>
          Remote cache as s3://bucket?endpoint=…&region=… (delete-capable creds) [env: KASHA_REMOTE=]
      --dry-run
          Print what would be deleted without deleting anything
      --grace-hours <GRACE_HOURS>
          Objects younger than this are never deleted [default: 24]
      --main-keep <MAIN_KEEP>
          Keep the N newest `main` generations per group [default: 5]
      --main-age-weeks <MAIN_AGE_WEEKS>
          Also keep `main` generations younger than this many weeks [default: 4]
      --other-keep <OTHER_KEEP>
          Keep the N newest non-`main` generations per group [default: 1]
      --other-age-weeks <OTHER_AGE_WEEKS>
          Also keep non-`main` generations younger than this many weeks [default: 1]
  -h, --help
          Print help
```
